The review also mentions "better iron stores" among the suggested advantages of delayed clamping, though it did not find sufficient data to report long-term blood counts (haemoglobin and ferritin) at six and twelve months.

question: On what date did Dr. Jose Rizal die, and what were the circumstances of his death?
